name: Sachet Water Sales Business
description: A retail business selling sachet water (pure water) in high-traffic areas, bus stops, and commercial centers. The business involves buying water in bulk from producers and reselling to the public. Low overhead costs with consistent daily demand make this an ideal starter business. Perfect for entrepreneurs looking to enter the retail sector with minimal capital.

name: Mobile Money (MoMo) Agent Business
description: Become an authorized Mobile Money agent providing cash-in, cash-out, and transfer services for MTN, Vodafone, or AirtelTigo. This business requires maintaining a float of GH₵2,000-3,000 and earns commissions on every transaction. With Ghana's rapid digital financial inclusion, MoMo agents are essential service providers in every community.

name: Backyard Vegetable Farming
description: Small-scale urban farming of high-demand vegetables like tomatoes, lettuce, cabbage, and peppers. Using efficient backyard or rooftop space, this business supplies fresh produce to local markets, restaurants, and households. Includes drip irrigation setup and organic farming practices for premium pricing.

name: Phone & Laptop Repair Shop
description: Professional repair services for smartphones, tablets, and laptops. Services include screen replacement, battery changes, software troubleshooting, and hardware repairs. With the high penetration of mobile devices in Ghana, this business meets constant demand. Includes tools, spare parts inventory, and small kiosk rental.

name: Small Food Stall - Waakye & Jollof
description: Traditional Ghanaian food stall serving popular dishes like waakye, jollof rice, fried rice, and accompanying proteins. Located in high-traffic areas near offices, schools, or markets. The business includes cooking equipment, initial food supplies, and basic stall setup. Daily cash flow with consistent customer base.

name: Poultry Farming - Layers & Broilers
description: Small-scale poultry farming producing both eggs (layers) and meat (broilers). Starting with 100-200 birds in a backyard coop setup. Includes construction of basic housing, feeders, drinkers, and initial feed supply. Strong market demand for both eggs and chicken meat ensures steady revenue streams.

name: Barbering Shop
description: Modern barbershop with 2-3 chairs offering haircuts, shaving, and grooming services. Located in a busy neighborhood or commercial area. Investment covers shop rent, barber chairs, clippers, mirrors, and initial supplies. Recurring customer base with add-on services like beard trimming and hair treatments.

name: Liquid Soap & Detergent Production
description: Manufacturing and bottling of liquid soap, dishwashing liquid, and detergents for household and commercial use. Products are sold to retailers, hotels, and directly to consumers. Low production costs with high profit margins. Includes raw materials, bottling equipment, and initial packaging supplies.

name: Event Photography Services
description: Professional photography services for weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, and graduations. Investment includes quality camera equipment, lenses, lighting, and editing software. Building a portfolio and online presence to attract clients. High-margin service business with weekend peak demand.

name: Sachet Water Production Factory
description: Medium-scale pure water production facility with automated filling and sealing machines. Includes borehole drilling, filtration system, packaging machine, and initial distribution setup. Produces 500-1000 bags daily for wholesale to retailers and vendors. Requires FDA certification and quality control measures.

name: Motorbike (Okada) Fleet Business
description: Commercial motorcycle taxi service with a fleet of 5-10 motorbikes. Bikes are rented to trained riders who pay daily or weekly fees. Strong demand in urban and peri-urban areas. Investment includes bike purchase, insurance, maintenance budget, and rider training. Generates passive daily income.

name: Bakery - Bread Production
description: Commercial bakery producing bread loaves, pastries, and baked goods for local distribution. Includes industrial oven, mixer, proofing equipment, and delivery van. Supplies to shops, schools, and households. Consistent demand with potential for contracts with institutions. Early morning production for fresh daily delivery.

name: Cold Store - Frozen Fish & Chicken
description: Cold storage facility for distributing frozen fish and chicken to retailers and market vendors. Investment includes industrial freezers, generator backup, and initial stock purchase. Steady demand from food vendors and households. Requires reliable power supply and proper storage management.

name: Fruit Juice & Smoothie Bar
description: Fresh fruit juice and smoothie bar serving healthy beverages made from local fruits like pineapple, watermelon, mango, and papaya. Located in health-conscious areas like gyms, offices, or shopping centers. Includes blenders, refrigeration, and fruit supply. Growing health and wellness trend supports demand.

name: Hair Salon & Braiding Studio
description: Full-service hair salon offering braiding, styling, weaving, treatments, and natural hair care. Targets women in residential or commercial areas. Investment includes salon chairs, mirrors, hair dryers, and initial inventory of extensions and products. Recurring clientele with high-margin services.

name: Graphic Design Agency
description: Professional graphic design services for businesses including logo design, branding, flyers, banners, and social media content. Serves SMEs, event organizers, and corporate clients. Investment in high-performance laptop, design software (Adobe Suite), and marketing. Remote work capability with low overhead.

name: Cleaning Services Company
description: Professional cleaning services for residential homes, offices, and commercial spaces. Services include deep cleaning, post-construction cleanup, and regular maintenance. Investment covers cleaning equipment, supplies, uniforms, and staff training. Contracts with offices and estates provide recurring revenue.

name: Mushroom Farming Business
description: Indoor mushroom cultivation of oyster and button mushrooms using controlled environment. High ROI with growing demand from restaurants, hotels, and health-conscious consumers. Investment includes growing room setup, substrate materials, spawn, and climate control. Harvest cycles of 4-6 weeks.

name: Catfish Farming - Plastic Tank Setup
description: Intensive catfish farming using plastic tanks or tarpaulin ponds in backyard spaces. Includes fingerlings, feed, aeration system, and water management. Harvest in 4-6 months with strong market demand from restaurants, hotels, and fish sellers. Space-efficient with high stocking density.

name: Grasscutter (Cane Rat) Rearing
description: Specialized grasscutter farming for bushmeat production. High-value protein source in high demand. Investment includes hutch construction, breeding stock, feed, and veterinary care. Grasscutters breed quickly with 8-month maturity. Premium pricing during festive seasons.

name: Commercial Printing Business
description: Printing services for flyers, banners, brochures, business cards, and promotional materials. Serves businesses, event organizers, and political campaigns. Investment in large format printer, cutting machine, and finishing equipment. High demand during campaign seasons and festive periods.

name: Catering Services - Events & Parties
description: Professional catering for weddings, corporate events, parties, and conferences. Includes industrial cooking equipment, serving ware, canopies, and chairs. Build reputation through quality service and referrals. Weekend peak demand with advance bookings. Can start small and scale with equipment rental.

name: Creche & Daycare Center
description: Licensed daycare facility for children aged 6 months to 5 years. Provides safe environment, learning activities, and meals for working parents. Investment includes facility rent, toys, learning materials, furniture, and staff salaries. Monthly subscription model provides steady cash flow.

name: Pharmacy & Chemical Shop
description: Licensed pharmacy or over-the-counter chemical shop selling medicines, health products, and first aid supplies. Requires professional pharmacist license. Located in residential area or near health facilities. Investment includes initial drug inventory, shelving, and refrigeration. Essential service with steady demand.

name: Real Estate Brokerage Agency
description: Real estate brokerage connecting property buyers and renters with landlords and developers. Commission-based business with low overhead. Investment in office space, marketing, property listings database, and networking. Growing urban housing demand creates opportunities. Digital marketing essential for lead generation.

name: Solar Panel Installation Services
description: Renewable energy business installing solar panels for homes and businesses. Services include system design, installation, and maintenance. Investment in tools, initial panel inventory, and technical training. Growing demand due to unreliable grid power. Government incentives support renewable energy adoption.

name: Hardware Store - Building Materials
description: Retail store selling cement, iron rods, roofing sheets, paint, plumbing, and electrical materials. Located near construction areas or residential developments. Investment in inventory, storage space, and delivery vehicle. Serves contractors, homeowners, and construction companies. Bulk sales to contractors.

name: Logistics & Delivery Company
description: Courier and delivery service using motorcycles and small vans. Serves e-commerce businesses, restaurants, and individuals. Investment includes vehicles, GPS tracking, insurance, and rider training. Partner with online platforms and businesses for steady contracts. Growing e-commerce drives demand.

name: Cosmetic Production - Shea Butter Products
description: Manufacturing natural cosmetics using Ghanaian shea butter. Products include body lotions, creams, soaps, and lip balms. Investment in raw materials, mixing equipment, packaging, and FDA certification. Export potential to international markets. Growing demand for natural and organic beauty products.

name: ICT Training Center
description: Computer training center offering courses in Microsoft Office, programming, graphic design, and digital marketing. Targets students, job seekers, and entrepreneurs. Investment in computers, software licenses, furniture, and curriculum development. Monthly class fees with certification programs.

name: Gym & Fitness Center
description: Modern fitness center with gym equipment, weights, cardio machines, and group classes. Offers personal training and nutrition counseling. Investment in equipment, space rental, trainers, and marketing. Monthly membership model provides recurring revenue. Health and wellness trend supports growth.

name: Carpentry & Furniture Workshop
description: Custom furniture manufacturing workshop producing beds, wardrobes, tables, chairs, and kitchen cabinets. Investment in woodworking machinery, tools, workshop space, and skilled labor. Serves homeowners, offices, and hotels. Custom orders and bulk contracts for institutions.

name: Phone Credit & Data Transfer Booth
description: Street-side booth selling airtime top-ups and performing electronic data transfers for all major Ghanaian networks. Low setup cost and steady daily traffic from commuters and neighborhood customers.

name: Shoe Polishing Service
description: Mobile and kiosk-based shoe shining service targeting offices, bus terminals, and markets. Requires minimal tools and offers fast turnover with repeat customers.

name: Errand & Delivery Runner
description: On-demand personal shopping, bill payments, and small parcel delivery for busy professionals and households. Uses a bicycle or motorbike for fast city coverage.

name: Boiled Egg & Pepper Stand
description: Popular street snack stand selling boiled eggs with pepper sauce at bus stops and evening hotspots. High margin, quick turnover, and tiny footprint.

name: Banana & Groundnut Street Cart
description: Cart-based sales of ripe bananas and roasted groundnuts at traffic stops and markets. Simple logistics with steady demand from commuters and students.

name: Toffee & Candy Vending
description: Street and kiosk sales of locally popular candies and toffees near schools and transport hubs. Very low startup with high rotation of small-ticket sales.

name: Lawn Mowing & Weeding Service
description: Neighborhood landscaping micro-business providing mowing, trimming, and weeding for homes and small offices. Uses basic tools and offers recurring subscriptions.

name: Home Tutoring (Primary/JHS)
description: After-school tutoring for primary and JHS students in math, English, and science. Sessions held at students' homes or community centers with flexible scheduling.

name: Book Editing & Proofreading
description: Freelance editing and proofreading for students, authors, and SMEs. Remote-friendly with minimal overhead, focusing on academic papers, reports, and manuscripts.

name: Social Media Profile Setup for SMEs
description: Service helping small shops and startups create Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok business profiles with branding basics and initial content calendar.

name: Online Product Review Microtasks
description: Microtasking team performing compliant product reviews and feedback for e-commerce sellers. Revenue from volume-based gigs; requires laptops and connectivity.

name: Article & Content Writing Agency
description: Content studio delivering blog posts, newsletters, and SEO articles for SMEs and startups. Remote writers with standardized editorial process and quick turnaround.

name: Mobile Car Washing Service
description: On-site car wash and detailing using water-efficient methods at offices and residences. Low equipment cost and flexible scheduling for fleet and private clients.

name: Customized Necktie Making
description: Handmade neckties using African prints for corporate clients, schools, and events. Small-scale production with niche fashion appeal and online sales.

name: Bead Making & Jewelry
description: Crafting traditional and modern bead jewelry for weddings, festivals, and export boutiques. Leverages local glass beads and online marketplace sales.

name: Snail Farming (Backyard)
description: Backyard snail rearing with starter pens, breeding stock, and feed. High-value protein with growing demand from restaurants and export buyers.

name: Laundry Pickup & Delivery
description: Door-to-door laundry and ironing with scheduled pickups for apartments and offices. Uses partner laundromats and focuses on logistics and customer service.

name: Mobile Notary Service
description: Certified notary traveling to clients for document authentication, affidavits, and business paperwork. Low overhead professional service with appointment model.

name: Virtual Assistant Services
description: Remote administrative support for SMEs and founders: email handling, scheduling, research, and customer responses. Subscription retainers and per-task billing.

name: Phone Accessories Kiosk
description: Kiosk retailing cases, chargers, earphones, and screen protectors near transport hubs and campuses. Fast-moving inventory with strong impulse buys.

name: Used Phone Reselling
description: Buying and refurbishing second-hand smartphones for resale online and in markets. Includes diagnostic tools and warranty policy to build trust.

name: Event Decor & Planning
description: Lightweight event decor and planning for birthdays, bridal showers, and corporate mixers. Investment in decor inventory, lighting, and transport.

name: Mini-Import Fashion & Cosmetics
description: Small-scale importation of trendy fashion items and cosmetics from Dubai/China for resale on Instagram and in pop-up stalls. Focus on fast fashion and beauty trends.

name: Small-Scale Pig Farming
description: Starting with 6-10 pigs, basic housing, and feed for local pork demand. Includes veterinary care and biosecurity to maintain healthy stock.

name: Clothing Line (Kente & Batik)
description: Boutique clothing line using Kente and Batik fabrics for ready-to-wear and custom orders. Online drops and pop-up events drive sales.

name: Pet Grooming Studio
description: Urban pet grooming for dogs and cats offering baths, nail trimming, and styling. Appointment-based with add-on retail of pet care products.

name: Bookkeeping Services for SMEs
description: Outsourced bookkeeping, invoicing, and basic payroll for small businesses. Uses cloud accounting tools to deliver monthly financials and compliance support.

name: Livestock Feed Production
description: Small mill producing maize-soy feed for poultry and pig farmers. Investment covers grinder, mixer, packaging, and initial raw material stock.

name: Travel & Tour Agency
description: Ticketing, visa assistance, and curated tour packages within Ghana and the region. Revenue from service fees and supplier commissions.

name: Car Rental Fleet (Small)
description: Small fleet of used saloon cars leased to vetted drivers or rented for self-drive. Includes insurance, maintenance plan, and GPS tracking.

name: Boutique Shop
description: Brick-and-mortar boutique selling curated fashion for men and women. Mix of imported pieces and local designs with social media-driven marketing.

name: Renewable Energy Infrastructure (Solar Farm)
description: Development of a 500kW community solar farm selling power to local grids and estates. Covers panels, inverters, land lease, and grid interconnect costs.

name: Commercial Fish Farming (Tilapia Ponds)
description: Earthen pond tilapia farming with aeration, feed, and fingerlings for wholesale to markets and restaurants. Includes cold-chain links for consistent sales.

name: Agro-Processing (Cashew & Cocoa Value-Add)
description: Processing cashew and cocoa into kernels, butter, and powder for local and export buyers. Includes roaster, sheller, grinder, and food safety certification.

name: Construction Company (Residential)
description: Small construction firm focused on residential builds and renovations. Covers tools, site team, project management, and compliance for building permits.

name: Petroleum & Lubricant Distribution
description: Distribution of lubricants and fuel to commercial transport fleets and workshops. Requires bulk storage, delivery truck, and supplier agreements.

name: Private Hospital & Clinic
description: Primary care clinic with pharmacy, lab, and minor procedure room serving urban neighborhoods. Includes medical equipment, licensing, and staff salaries.

name: Private Security Firm
description: Licensed security company providing guards, patrols, and alarm response for estates, offices, and retail. Investment in training, uniforms, radios, and control room setup.

name: E-commerce Marketplace Platform
description: Online marketplace for local vendors with integrated payments, logistics partners, and storefront tools. Revenue from commissions, ads, and subscriptions.

name: Biotechnology Diagnostics Lab
description: Specialized diagnostics lab offering advanced tests for oncology and infectious diseases. Requires certified equipment, cold chain, and specialist staff.

name: Smart Home & IoT Services
description: Installation of smart locks, lighting, security cameras, and energy monitors for homes and offices. Includes support plans and device sourcing partnerships.

name: Heavy Equipment Rental
description: Rental of excavators, compactors, and backhoes to contractors on daily and weekly terms. Covers equipment acquisition, transport, and maintenance fund.

name: Waste Management (Borla Taxi)
description: Door-to-door waste collection using tricycles and small trucks, serving estates and markets. Revenue from subscription pickups and municipal contracts.

name: Microfinance Institution
description: Licensed micro-lending platform offering group loans and micro-savings to traders and artisans. Requires regulatory capital, risk controls, and collections team.

name: Mining Support Services
description: Support services for gold and bauxite mines: equipment haulage, camp maintenance, and safety supplies. Contracts with mining firms drive revenue stability.

name: Beverage Manufacturing Plant
description: Production of bottled soft drinks and flavored beverages for local distribution. Covers filling line, bottles, branding, and FDA certification.

name: Fertilizer Production Plant
description: Production of organic and inorganic fertilizers for smallholder farmers. Includes blending equipment, bagging line, and distribution partnerships.

name: Textile Mill
description: Medium-scale textile mill producing local fabrics for wholesale. Investment in looms, dyeing, finishing, and quality control systems.

name: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
description: Production of essential medicines and generics for the local market. Requires GMP facility setup, QA systems, and NAFDAC/FDA approvals.

name: Cybersecurity Agency
description: Managed security services including vulnerability assessments, SOC monitoring, and incident response for SMEs and banks.

name: App Development Studio
description: Studio building mobile and web apps for SMEs and funded startups. Revenue from project fees and maintenance retainers.

name: Accounting Software Reseller
description: Reselling and implementing accounting software for SMEs with training and support packages. Partner commissions plus service revenue.

name: Interior Design Studio
description: Residential and small-office interior design with 3D renders and curated furniture sourcing. Project-based fees with procurement margins.

name: Tutoring Agency Network
description: Agency matching vetted tutors to parents and schools, covering STEM, languages, and test prep. Commission model on monthly lesson fees.

name: Landscaping & Gardening Services
description: Full-service landscaping for homes and estates: design, planting, irrigation, and maintenance. Contracts provide recurring monthly revenue.

name: Organic Manure Production
description: Composting organic waste into manure for vegetable farmers. Includes shredders, compost bays, and bagging for retail distribution.

name: Herbal Medicine Retail Shop
description: Licensed retail of certified herbal remedies, teas, and supplements. Targets wellness-focused customers with physician consultation partnerships.

name: Bakery Supply Shop
description: Wholesale and retail of flour, sugar, yeast, and packaging to bakers and food vendors. High inventory turnover with steady B2B relationships.

name: Auto-Electrician Workshop
description: Diagnostic and repair workshop for modern car electronics, wiring, and ECUs. Includes scan tools, lifts, and training for technicians.

name: Printing Consumables Store
description: Retail and small wholesale of toner, ink cartridges, and paper to offices, schools, and print shops. Strong repeat demand and predictable reorders.

name: Second-Hand Clothing Wholesale
description: Bulk purchase of foseline bales for resale to market traders. Requires storage, sorting, and quick turnover of graded clothing bundles.

name: Ice Block Production Facility
description: Ice block production for fishmongers, food vendors, and events. Investment in ice machines, cold storage, and generator backup.

name: Event Ushering Agency
description: Provides trained ushers and protocol staff for weddings, corporate events, and conferences. Revenue per event with add-on coordination services.

name: Beekeeping (Apiculture)
description: Apiary producing honey and beeswax for local retail and export. Investment in hives, protective gear, and bottling equipment.

name: MC & Event Hosting
description: Professional master of ceremonies for weddings, corporate events, and concerts. Income from event fees and partnerships with DJs and planners.

name: Podcast Production Studio
description: Audio production studio for podcasts and voice-overs with recording, editing, and distribution services. Revenue from studio time and post-production packages.

name: Handyman Services
description: On-demand household repairs: plumbing fixes, electrical swaps, and minor carpentry. Appointments and subscription maintenance plans for homes and offices.

name: FinTech Payments & Micro-Lending Startup
description: Digital wallet and micro-lending platform with KYC, agent network, and credit scoring for informal sector users. Revenue from transaction fees and loan interest.
